crossRefs.note: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into Yahweh’s house:
He lifted up his face to the window, and said, “Who is on my side? Who?” Two or three eunuchs looked out at him.

parallels.note: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into Yahweh’s house:

people.name: Athaliah
people.line: Queen of Judah, daughter of Ahab and Jezebel

translations.web: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into Yahweh’s house.
translations.bsb: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and cheering the king, she went out to them in the house of the LORD.
translations.kjv: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of the LORD:
translations.asv: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of Jehovah:
